title: Stripe appearance acceptance receipt
description: Evidence that a real Stripe test-mode surface accepted the Ink & Foil candidate appearance, captured at the lifecycle moments the product consumes it. Written only by a fully configured, zero-skip probe run against a qualifying deployed staging host; a skipped, partial, control-mode, or failing run emits nothing, and any run whose retained artifacts matched a configured secret or buyer/session/order/payment marker emits nothing either. Records environment variable names only, never values. The schema constrains shape; ink-foil-candidate-fixture.test.ts binds the receipt to the exact bytes, commit, command, and observation contract it claims.

surface.description: Which provider surface was probed. The Elements surface is owned by #6698; the Connect surface by #6699.

implementationHead.description: The 40-character commit the probe ran against. The validator requires it to resolve to a reachable commit and permits only the receipt artifact itself to differ between it and the validating head.

fixtureSha256.description: sha256 of the committed candidate fixture bytes the expectations were read from.

sourceDigests.description: sha256 of every committed file that can change what the provider was sent: the appearance factory, the candidate fixture, and the probe spec. Binding these rather than the containing commit avoids the impossible self-reference of a receipt naming the commit that adds it.

host.description: Origin of the qualifying deployed staging host, with no credential, path, or query component. A lane sandbox carries no Stripe configuration and can never be an acceptance host.

environmentVariableNames.description: Names only. A value here is a leak.

substitutionsApplied.description: Pre-authorised anchor substitutions the provider forced during this run. Empty when the ratified values were accepted as-is; anything present must match a pre-authorised substitution recorded in the candidate fixture.

retentionScan.description: Proof that every retained artifact was compared against the run's actual configured secrets and buyer/session/order/payment markers before it existed. A non-zero hit count means the run refused to write anything, so a receipt can only ever carry zero.

resolvedTokens.description: Every custom property the appearance factory consumed, resolved from the probed document at this moment.

screenshotClip.description: Retained screenshots are cropped to the provider frame; the crop is the redaction, because buyer identity and page chrome live outside it.

observation.description: One named frame-internal observable: what the provider actually rendered, against an expectation read from the committed fixture.

paintedOver.description: Required on every border observation and forbidden elsewhere: the ratified dark border is a translucent rgba value, so the surface it is painted over and the resulting opaque composite are both recorded and both re-derived from the fixture by the validator.
